recommendations.body: `_require_active_structural_candidate()` and `_store_active_structural_replacement()` in `plan_tool/roadmap_candidate_review.py` (step 3 “Add one explicit structural approve, edit, or reject decision while retaining immutable candidate history”) retain the candidate/evidence snapshot read before model work and, at publication, check only the admission pointer and ledger. A hand change to the active candidate, its evidence, root/source binding, or review binding can therefore publish a seal, supersession, or terminal resolution against stale bytes, violating the required no-partial-publication boundary
recommendations.suggested_action: reload and validate the active candidate and its persisted evidence against the current admission immediately in every structural decision `before_replace` callback

recommendations.body: `tests/test_roadmap_candidate_review.py` and `tests/test_roadmap_candidate_run.py` (step 3 “Add one explicit structural approve, edit, or reject decision while retaining immutable candidate history”) cover the happy-path decision flow but do not exercise the declared stale/substituted candidate, publication-window pointer-or-ledger change, immutable-history, or decision-binding replay contracts, so regressions in the required atomicity fence can pass focused tests
